# Project Instructions

- Before finishing any task that changes the project, add a concise, newest-first entry to the root `CHANGELOG.md` describing what changed and why.
- Include the relevant tests, build, or other validation in that entry. If no validation was available, say so.
- Keep changes focused on the requested task and follow the existing project conventions.
- Do not add a framework, dependency, or generated application scaffold until the project requirements call for it.
- Update `README.md` when setup steps, project structure, or development workflows change.
- Never start, launch, or restart the website or any local server unless the user explicitly asks you to do so in the current prompt. Inspecting whether a server is running is allowed; do not stop or kill a server unless explicitly asked.
